51070506.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant wild-type human pancreatic glucokinase expressed in Escherichia coli K-12 at 100 uM by isothermal titration calorimetry in presence of 200 mM glucose
51070506.references_previous: Anderka, O.; Boyken, J.; Aschenbach, U.; Batzer, A.; Boscheinen, O.; Schmoll, D. Biophysical characterization of the interaction between hepatic glucokinase and its regulatory protein. J. Biol. Chem. 2008, 283, 31333–31340.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 (Malvern Instruments, Inc.) at 25 °C. The glucokinase (GCK) protein (100 μM) was loaded into the sample cell, and the activator (100–200 μM) was loaded into the syringe. The buffer used was 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 100 mM KCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.01% Tween-20, and 200 mM glucose. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The first injection was 0.4 μL. Data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (MicroCal) with a one-site binding model. The experiments were performed in triplicate, and the data are presented as the mean ± SD. The binding affinity (Kd) was calculated from the fit of the data to the one-site binding model. The thermodynamic parameters (ΔH, ΔS, and ΔG) were calculated from the fitted data. The control experiments were performed by titrating the activator into buffer alone to correct for the heat of dilution.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. (A) Representative isotherm for GKA22 (110 μM) binding to glucokinase (11 μM) in the presence of glucose. (B) Representative isotherm for CpdA (100 μM) binding to glucokinase (10 μM) in the presence of glucose. Thermodynamic parameters represent the average of two or more independent experiments.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 (Malvern Instruments, Inc.) at 25 °C. The sample cell was loaded with 11 μM recombinant wild-type human pancreatic glucokinase in 20 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 100 mM KCl, 1 mM DTT, 10% glycerol, and 200 mM glucose. The syringe contained 110 μM GKA22 in the same buffer. The protein was titrated with 20 μL injections of the ligand at 120 s intervals. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. Data were analyzed using MicroCal Origin 7.0 software. The binding isotherm was fitted to a single-site binding model. The control experiment involved titrating the ligand into buffer alone. The thermodynamic parameters were calculated from the fitted data. The experiments were performed in triplicate, and the data represent the average of two or more independent experiments.
